About us

The back office behind small businesses.

Marler Enterprises LLC is an administrative services company built for small businesses. Bookkeeping is at the heart of what we do, with notary services, form preparation and day-to-day office support alongside it.

Our team brings more than 25 years of experience in property management and real estate, so we also offer specialized bookkeeping for the real estate industry: rent rolls, tenant ledgers, security deposits and vendor payments.

We keep the books balanced, the paperwork filed and the office running, so owners can spend their time on the work they started the business to do.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

Marler Enterprises LLC ("we," "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information this website collects and how we use it.

Information we collect

When you use our contact form, we collect the information you enter: your name, email address, the service you are interested in and your message. We do not use this site to collect payment information, and we do not require an account.

How we use it

We use your information only to respond to your request, schedule a consultation and provide the services you ask for.

How it is shared

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information. Contact form messages are delivered to our inbox through a third-party form service (FormSubmit). We may disclose information if required by law.

Client records

Financial records and documents you share with us as a client are kept confidential and used only to perform the work you hired us for.

How long we keep it

We keep contact form messages only as long as needed to respond and maintain normal business records.

Your choices

You can ask us to update or delete the information you sent us at any time by contacting us through the form on this page.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The date above shows when it was last changed.
